description: R-SQL-1 SQL-SUB-03: How are correlated names bound: an inner alias L that shadows the outer table L, an outer alias L2 with the child naming L, nested EXISTS both correlated to L, several outer LD rows with equal id, an unqualified inner name found only in the outer table, and a declared parameter named like an inner column (PARAMETERS lid Long, value 1, on a temporary QueryDef with its Parameters enumerated)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
